allow: PowerShell(foreach \($id in 8328, 22744, 23028\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "Stopped $id" } catch { "Could not stop $id : $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $\($c.OwningProcess\)" | Select-Object ProcessId, CommandLine | Format-List } else { "Port 3000 is free" })
PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { "Port 3000 in use by PID $\($c.OwningProcess\)" } else { "Port 3000 is free" })

PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = 10428" | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, CreationDate, CommandLine | Format-List; $p = \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = 10428"\).ParentProcessId; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $p" | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, CommandLine | Format-List)
